description: ERC-8004 Reputation-registry off-chain feedback file shape (spec MUST fields + proofOfPayment for x402) plus one namespaced 'cwi' extension block. Run-2 decision: every cwi.evidence item MUST carry a machine-checkable source pointer, or the record fails validation.

agentId.description: On-chain agent id. Pre-registration: the literal string TBD.

agentRegistry.description: CAIP-2 chain + identity registry, e.g. eip155:1:0x.... Pre-registration: the literal string TBD.

clientAddress.description: Feedback giver. Spec: SHOULD be the agentWallet address when the client is an agent. Pre-designation: TBD.

engine_input_sha256.description: input_sha256 from the trust-verdict engine run this record's evidence was scored with.

source.description: Machine-checkable pointer: URL, repo path, or content hash. Never a bare assertion.

value_semantics.description: REQUIRED when tag1 is not a spec-table convention: what the value number means.

feedbackHash.description: keccak256 of the file at feedbackURI (64 hex chars). REQUIRED when record_status=submittable.

proofOfPayment.description: x402 payment proof — the receipts-to-portable-trust linkage. Omitted until real x402 settlements exist.

record_status.description: prep-draft = chain facts not yet real (TBD placeholders allowed). submittable = every spec MUST field is concrete and feedbackHash present.

value.description: Signed fixed-point feedback value (int128 on chain; exact range enforced by validate_reputation.py).

title: CWI ERC-8004 Reputation Feedback Record
